video.title: Riot Games are terrible at publishing comics - here's why, and ways to solve it
video.description:
UPDATE: Per Zoharan (see pinned comment), the Universe DOES have a filter feature to show comics under the "explore" subheading. They did not have that the last time I went looking around the site before making the video, but I'm VERY glad they've finally added it! It does seem to be missing the Kai'sa comic, the Camille release comic and the Spirit Guard Udyr comic, though.

-------------------

I have argued for a long time, and loudly, that comics are a fantastic way to explore the League of Legends IP. Riot Games, for their part, have been doing a much better job having comics made that do exactly that.

But, and I hate to put it so bluntly, they are terrible at publishing them. The most important thing when publishing, well, ANY content online, is discoverability: It needs to be as easy as possible for people to find the things you make. And on Riot's websites, discoverability is often almost nil.

Let's talk about that for a bit

--------------------

GO READ THE COMICS

OLAF VS EVERYTHING (by Tom Barton): https://na.leagueoflegends.com/en/news/community/community-spotlight/new-comic-olaf-vs-everything-season-1
---------
PUNCHES & PLANTS (by Risu): https://na.leagueoflegends.com/en/news/community/community-spotlight/punches-and-plants-piltover-police-story
---------
ACADEMY ADVENTURES (by Gutter Rat)
SEASON 1: https://na.leagueoflegends.com/en/news/community/community-spotlight/academy-adventures
SEASON 2: https://na.leagueoflegends.com/en/news/community/community-spotlight/academy-adventures-season-2
---------
CRYSTAL QUEST (by ARTeapot): na.leagueoflegends.com/en/news/community/community-spotlight/new-weekly-comic-crystal-quest

--------------------

Patreon: http://patreon.com/castercomix
